svg.title: The release watch
svg.desc: Four steps: roll out, watch for ten minutes, decide against thresholds, keep the release. A crossed threshold takes a dashed path to an automatic rollback of the previous release. An unreadable probe is skipped and never causes a rollback.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: production is the last check: watch the release, roll back by rule
